rule: council/trader.mjs nqOpenSweep(bars, day, 570, 0, 0.0008, 0.00011) + nyflip (midnight open ahead) + nqRun trail [2, 1], 10R cap, out 11:00 ET

walkForward.method: each year: pick the best of 20 cells (run 0.04-0.14% x midnight filter on/off x runner/2R) by total R over the previous 3 clean years, trade it the next year

walkForwardSwitch.method: live rule, traded in a year only if the previous 2 years summed > 0

regime.switch: trade only when the 09:30 open is on the chosen side of the prior 200-day average of 09:30 opens
